name: Zuwena Haraldsdóttir-Maputo
role: Neighborhood council member and mutual aid organizer
location: Highland Park Autonomous Zone, near Lake Shore Drive and Division
description:
Zuwena is a broad-shouldered woman with deep umber skin and silver-streaked locs she keeps pinned under a battered orange headwrap when she's working. Her left forearm has a subdermal map of Highland Park tattooed in bioluminescent ink — a gift from the community after her third term — and she traces it absently with her fingernail when she's thinking. Her face is a landscape of laugh lines and hard-won patience, and she has the particular stillness of someone who has learned that the room will eventually come to her.

She runs the HPAZ Resource Exchange from a converted auto-garage that smells of pine cleaner and instant noodles, coordinating food distribution, housing mediation, and emergency flood response across eleven blocks. People call her The Cartographer not because she makes maps but because she seems to know where everyone is and what they need before they know it themselves. She is warm to the point of being disarming, which has caused more than one corporate liaison to underestimate her until she produces the seventeen-page legal brief she's been sitting on.

core_fears: Outliving her usefulness to the community
Being replaced by a corporate-backed 'community partner' org
core_desires: To see Highland Park genuinely self-sufficient before she dies
To sleep through a full night without her comm pinging
coping_mechanisms: Walking the perimeter of the zone when anxious
blind_spots: She absorbs other people's crises as personal failures
She trusts institutional loyalty over individual warning signs
psychology.secret: She accepted a one-time anonymous donation of Φ40,000 to keep the Exchange open during the 2196 flood crisis, and she's never been able to verify the source. She suspects it was Tessera goodwill money meant to buy her silence on a zoning dispute, and she spent it anyway, which keeps her awake.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Plain, concrete, directive. Uses the specific names of things — street names, people's full names, exact numbers. Rarely abstracts.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and unhurried. Long pauses before answering. Never interrupts.
verbal_tics: 'Let me tell you what I know.'
example_lines: 'The pipe on Nardin burst again. I've filed seventeen complaints. Here's eighteen.'
'I'm not going to tell you what to do. I'm going to tell you what's actually happening and let you find your conscience.'

story_hooks: The anonymous Φ40,000 donor has reappeared — this time with conditions attached.
A younger council member is quietly organizing to vote Zuwena out, backed by residents who find her 'too confrontational' with Tessera.
narrative_function: Quest giver and community anchor. She knows everyone's needs and most of their secrets. Players seeking information about Highland Park, resources, or local history route through her. She also represents the cost of sustained civic leadership on one person's body and spirit.
augmentations: Subdermal bioluminescent map tattoo (cosmetic). Basic retinal HUD for document reading — second-hand, slightly glitchy.
daily_life: Mornings she walks the twelve blocks of her jurisdiction before the Exchange opens, stopping to talk, note damage, check on the elderly. Evenings she runs mediation sessions or attends council meetings that routinely run until midnight.
affiliation: Highland Park Autonomous Zone Community Council; loose affiliation with the Meridian Labor Solidarity Network

decision_rules: Act on what you can verify, not what you fear
Never make a promise you can't keep inside this zone's resources
Let people finish before you respond
escalation_ladder: Civil disobedience as last resort — she's done it twice

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Observant and welcoming, but slow to offer her full name — she lets people arrive at trust themselves.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Ferociously loyal, openly affectionate, the person who remembers birthdays and the anniversaries of losses.

stress_responses.medium: Gets very still and quiet. Makes tea. Writes lists.
stress_responses.high: Disappears on a solo walk for two hours, returns with a plan.

contradictions: Deeply committed to collective action but runs the Exchange almost entirely herself because delegation has failed her before
habits: Leaves data offerings at the Exchange's embedded E.L.F. shrine every morning — invoice files, neighborhood census data, 'so it knows what we need'
Carries a physical notebook even though it's anachronistic
breaking_points: A child being harmed through an institution she vouched for
Discovering the anonymous donation source and having it be worse than she feared

related_entities: Palladian Construction MagRail Spur MRS-17 Elevated Micro-Transit Chassis

physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and substantial without heaviness; years of physical labor and community work have built genuine muscle density across her frame. Posture of someone comfortable taking up space.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with natural silver threading throughout
physical_description.hair_style: Locs, shoulder-length when loose, habitually pinned and wrapped
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with faint HUD overlay artifacts visible under certain light angles (second-hand retinal implant)
physical_description.complexion: Well-maintained skin marked by laugh lines radiating from eyes and mouth, evidence of decades of sustained expression. Minimal scarring. Grooming is practical and unhurried—she does not fight her appearance but wears it as earned territory.
distinguishing_marks: Subdermal bioluminescent map of Highland Park (11-block jurisdiction) running across the entire inner surface of her left forearm—faintly visible under skin, glows soft blue-green in low light, streets rendered in fine detail with major resource nodes marked
Fine network of old work scars on both palms and knuckles, consistent with garage work and hands-on repair
Small burn scar on right temple from a heating unit mishap (pre-augmentation era)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Subdermal map tattoo visible as faint luminous tracery on left forearm. Retinal HUD not externally visible but occasionally detectable as brief digital artifacts in her eyes when she's reading or accessing information—a slight lag or flicker that betrays the second-hand implant's age.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy—no wasted motion. Sits and stands with the particular stillness of someone accustomed to being the calm center of chaos. When thinking, she traces her left forearm absently with her right fingernail, activating faint bioluminescent pulses. Her presence has gravitas; rooms don't need her to raise her voice.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian. Worn but maintained: reinforced canvas work pants (dirt-stained but patched cleanly), layered thermal shirts in muted earth tones, a heavy synthetic-wool coat salvaged and re-lined. The battered orange headwrap is her signature—faded from original brightness, knotted at the back, occasionally slipping to reveal the silver-streaked locs beneath. Work boots resoled at least twice. No jewelry except a thin woven cord bracelet made from scraps contributed by residents—unofficial badge of office.
